_comment: SEED gold set for the lexical link-suggestion eval baseline (LWM_022 / ADR-0022). Hand-labeled correct (source-stem -> target-stem) links grounded in the REAL pages of tests/fixtures/wikis/populated. This is a small SEED to be expanded to a few hundred labels (including a held-out, SHA256-frozen real gate wiki) per the PRD. Invariants: tune and gate splits are disjoint by query; the gate split holds a gibberish negative that must return empty. Target ids are page file stems (underscored), matching the suggester's target_stem output.

items.note: A CNN is a neural network; suggester surfaces the plain-text mention.
PyTorch is a deep learning framework.
TensorFlow is a deep learning framework.
Correct link the lexical suggester misses: the term only appears inside an existing wikilink, so it is never surfaced as a candidate (honest recall miss).
Gibberish query: a correct system returns nothing.
Fine-tuning is a form of transfer learning.
